scope: Focused Code Ready review for one authorized new measurement panel only; no science execution inferred

tests.test_kind: Artificial small tensors and mocked Popen/start-gate only; no real processes, source assets, NN, AD, SVD, FEM or solve

checks: A uses unchanged Runtime.trial and original source/physics/BC/head/realization/rank contracts; seven fresh maps, no candidate promotion or optimization/history path.
B is the explicit anchored chart field family savedPhi+(Dxi-D0)T0 with source raw UV head; reuses each signed A side existing feature tensor. B is never installed as an actual NN.
Two optional legacy observer hooks expose only already-computed features and native trace; no extra model/physical evaluation.

Qv requested once; original derivative mismatch is recorded as observation, while nonfinite/state/rank/head/realization/rollback failures stop. Each completed pair saves raw FD/difference/error/scale/tolerance immediately, before later panel sides.
A actual fields/basis/readout and B free fields/z/gradient/trace/solver plus actual B Phi persist for later saved-output verification.

Scientific Guard and legacy evaluation budget are both capped at500 energy/50 assemblies/7 SVD and600 seconds. Resource card holds16GiB RSS/CUDA allocated/reserved,8GiB task,4CPU, selected GPU index5/UUID and4GiB physical spare; fresh no-conflict admission remains required.

Controller is gated before package hashes; independent outer pidfd guardian covers controller/sealing within fixed absolute envelope, inner pidfd guardian bounds scientific worker600s. SIGALRM covers absolute envelope as an additional stop; only owned processes are stopped.

Postexit export schema now matches verifier: only three final logs excluded, each<=1MiB before hash, root/path/size/SHA provided, run_id and export_manifest SHA bound; exclusive outer return receipt outside sealed roots.
Exact authority overlay binds new package/run/family; claim is consumed once, no retry/resume/reconnect path in this launcher.
resolved_findings: Absolute SIGALRM moved ahead of package verification; independent outer guardian added before controller gate.
Explicit initial20GiB admission avoids the legacy default28GiB;4GiB spare monitored.
Postexit receipt schema aligned with existing retrieval verifier and bounded log hashes.
B actualPhi is saved rather than relying only on solver metadata; completed comparisons no longer wait for all11maps.
limitations: This is static/tiny-fixture Code Ready only, not proof of actual resource fit, scientific completion, derivative consistency, root cause or improvement.
Physical head tolerance remains1e-10; B is a field control, not an NN endpoint; no scientific success inferred from any gate alone.
Local staging/retrieval subprocesses must obey the same fixed absolute envelope and4GiB retrieval cap; this review does not independently execute those external steps.
Final producer package and authority require exact source/package binding after commit; no stale prior R2 package may run this code.
Partial output stays partial; old R2 failed outcome and missing old Qv remain unchanged.
